# `adt activate`

Activate inactive ABAP objects (by files, package, or transport)

```bash
adt activate [options] [files...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                                                                    | Default |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `[files...]` | Specific files or glob patterns (e.g., zage_fixed_values.doma.xml, *.doma.xml) |         |

**Options**

| Option                      | Description                                           | Default   |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-s, --source <path>`       | Source directory containing serialized files          | `.`       |
| `-f, --format <format>`     | Format plugin: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit | `abapgit` |
| `-p, --package <package>`   | Activate all objects in a package                     |           |
| `-t, --transport <request>` | Activate all objects in a transport request           |           |
| `--types <types>`           | Filter by object types (comma-separated)              |           |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
